name: How much does a luxury kitchen renovation cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a luxury kitchen renovation cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a luxury kitchen renovation in Los Angeles can vary significantly, typically ranging from $75,000 to over $200,000, depending on the scope and selections. Factors influencing price include the size of the kitchen, quality of materials (e.g., custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, exotic countertops), structural modifications, and labor for specialized installations. We provide detailed, transparent proposals after understanding your vision and requirements during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury kitchen renovations in Los Angeles generally range from $75,000 to over $200,000, based on size, materials, and scope.
